intent: Средняя юнитэкономика периода на исходно заказанную единицу
period_basis: One requested calendar period; ordered value for noncancelled units, all recognized platform costs for the period

optional_user_inputs.cogs_per_unit: If absent: omit COGS explicitly and label result before COGS; never invent cost
optional_user_inputs.tax: If absent or excluded: do not calculate tax; label before tax
optional_user_inputs.own_costs: Only supplied actual costs; omissions disclosed

rules: Denominator is every originally ordered unit including cancelled
Exclude cancelled value from order revenue
COGS applies to noncancelled quantity only
Keep all actual non-COGS platform costs including costs incurred on cancelled/returned orders
Do not filter period financial fees by current order status
Finance may later contain promotion_with_cost_per_order and pay_per_click: reconcile to Performance and count advertising once
External Performance report is a control when matching finance ad lines already exist
No universal finance+external_ads addition; no omission or duplication of unmatched advertising
Empty/null/missing mandatory source never means zero
Reconcile complete FBO+FBS ordered quantities and values to analytics
Use finite Decimal and explicit RUB; decode price as amount/currency when API returns an object
Period model is not final realized cohort profit; open orders and later financial corrections disclosed
No per-question Python finance handler; generic row reducers plus scalar expressions

formula.period_expense: sum(all signed commission/services/return fee adjustments), normalized as actual expenses and refunds; classify ad overlap before adding any external-only ad spend

zero_denominator: Explain undefined; never divide by zero
installation_gap: Monetary cancellation projection and C-UE01 worker adapter are not installed; manual source-backed owner result does not close runtime capability
review_note: See METHODOLOGY_CORRECTION.md. Manual period arithmetic on unlinked order value and financial-day fees is not validated product unit economics.

unit_profiles.owner_order_report: Fixed original order group; actual vs estimated revenue/cost states explicit; cancelled revenue and COGS excluded, incurred other costs retained
unit_profiles.actual_financial_period: Sales/costs on consistent financial recognition basis with disclosed shared allocation
unit_profiles.product_forecast: Unchanged product cost input and explicit tariffs/probabilities; forecast labelled

forbidden_claims: Allocated COGS per original order is not product cost per unit
Open noncancelled quantity is not realized quantity
Same date does not prove order revenue and financial fees belong to same orders
Changing denominator alone does not validate profit
